segments.title: Lethal Company Co-op Playthrough
segments.notes: Case Blackwell hosts an extended Lethal Company co-op session with mods Malco, Fiona, and Exterminator; crew scavenges moons, battles monsters, manages quota, and loses multiple crewmates across several in-game days.

segments.title: Kissinger Death Commentary
segments.notes: Case breaks from gameplay to remark on Henry Kissinger's death, offering a critical summary of his diplomatic career and role in American hegemony, framed as 'news for the day' from space.

segments.title: Stream Wrap-Up and Raid
segments.notes: Case promotes the Cream Team Dreamstream and Patreon, confirms return for news tomorrow, and raids Raddy Daddy after briefly considering Maude Garrett and Cycord.

lore_notes.fact: Hosts Cream Team Dreamstream and Patreon alongside main BIN broadcast [01:45:22]
Delivers critical commentary on Henry Kissinger's death during gameplay stream [01:42:19]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell spends the majority of the broadcast co-op streaming Lethal Company with a crew of mods, navigating quota runs, monster encounters, and repeated crew deaths across multiple moons. In the final minutes, he pivots to a brief news commentary on Henry Kissinger's death before promoting the Cream Team Dreamstream and raiding Raddy Daddy.
